transcript: Yesterday, my sister and I saw volcano at St Ann’s Warehouse This was an epic four-act, four-hour experience featuring two performers in a room enclosed within glass. It was mostly a movement piece and somewhat of a sci-fi thriller. The production design and the performances were extremely impressive and intricate but I do think it was a little out there considering the amount of time the piece demanded of our attention. It explores themes of existentialism, consciousness, and the documentation of human existence. But basic questions like who these characters are, where they are, and what they're doing are all not very obviously answered. Although it reveals more of itself as it progresses, it became pretty clear to me by the end of episode three that we were not going to get an explanation for everything. That being said, please sound off in the comments if you attended this and have any interpretations. I'm very curious what others thought. With that, another program for my collection.
